fixture_change.changes: Only leaf/owned/request JSON marker writes use same-directory temp+rename. Report JSON after closed remains strictly parsed. Existing assertions unchanged.

static_findings: First SIGINT/SIGTERM aborts waits/requests and releases held poll barriers. Repeated signals return without process.exit or restoring default termination.
Abort-aware migration and request waits propagate to finally; finally is the sole group-termination owner after root removed eager handler TERM loops.
Original operational failures, including migration exit23, retain failure; interruption is separately recorded and cannot overwrite them.
Pending promises capture rejection on creation, barriers release in interrupt and finally, pending settlement is bounded at5s before proxy/service closure.
Group inspection uses bounded validated ps membership, not kill0 EPERM as cleanup success. Real termination EPERM remains an error; malformed/empty inspection is failclosed.
Cleanup TERM/KILL phases and ps are bounded, force-kill retains the original inspection error, owned process failures retain temporary resources and FAIL.
The round14 test adaptation only records/accepts a final signal0 EPERM diagnostic; socket closure/rebind, live sibling and stop/repeat error assertions remain strict.
limitations: No complete HTTP runner, application build, model, training, deployment or deep round14 native suite was run.
Native8 uses synthetic Wrangler/material-service replacements with real CLI subprocesses/signals and kernel sockets, not production Worker business acceptance.
Its pending mode hangs the first /api/cases request; it does not dynamically reach the internal held fact-job pendingPoll barrier. That release path was statically reviewed only.

Native signals cover first SIGINT at startup, first SIGTERM at migration/pending/failure and repeated SIGTERM during cleanup. Repeated SIGINT and mixed signal sequences share the same statically reviewed handler but were not separately executed.
Native platform was macOS; no native Windows or Linux retained-zombie acceptance was performed in this review.
An initial attempted interrupt log redirect preceded creation of its evidence directory, so that shell invocation did not launch tests; it is excluded from test counts.
